concerns.text: FR-007 (exclude malformed scenes) and US-1 (ambiguous constraints) require logging exclusion counts and IDs. Task T013 is marked incomplete and depends on T012 (incomplete). No task exists to generate the 'exclusion_log.json' artifact if T012 fails or if T013 is skipped, leaving FR-007 unimplemented.

SC-005 (success condition: ≥85% accuracy) and the 'Threshold Justification' assumption require a sensitivity analysis. Tasks T030a and T030b are marked incomplete. Without these, the project cannot validate the success condition against varying thresholds, leaving SC-005 untestable.

FR-006 and US-3 require categorizing failures and generating a report with counts and examples. Task T022 (generate failure_analysis_report.md) is marked incomplete. T021 (logic) depends on T019 (benchmark results), which is also incomplete. No task covers the final report generation if T019/T022 are skipped.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle VII (Baseline Integrity) require explicit verification artifacts. Tasks T026 (acceptance_checker) and T027 (vlm_trace_auditor) are marked incomplete. Without these, the plan cannot prove compliance with the Constitution, leaving the project's validity unverified.

Plan.md and spec.md define schema contracts (dataset.schema.yaml, etc.) as pre-implementation design artifacts. Task T005 (create schema contracts) is marked incomplete. Without these schemas, T029 (dry-run validation) and T010 (extract_geometry) cannot validate data compliance, blocking FR-001 and FR-007.

Edge Cases in spec.md require handling 'insufficient constraints' without crashing. Task T028 (error handling for ConstraintSatisfactionError) is marked incomplete. If T012 (solver) runs without T028, the system may crash on ambiguous inputs, violating the spec's edge case requirements.
